section: Convection fan: motor speed controller control voltages & link positions
markdown:
Link positions are factory pre-set based on the model of convection fan used in the conneX ovens. The link positions must not be altered without express instruction from Merrychef.

| Oven Variant   | 13A & 15A/16A   | 30A          |
|----------------|-----------------|--------------|
| Input %        | 0 - 10 Volts    | 0 - 10 Volts |
| 10             | 2               | 2            |
| 20             | 2.8             | 2.8          |
| 30             | 3.5             | 3.5          |
| 40             | 4.3             | 4.3          |
| 50             | 5               | 5            |
| 60             | 5.5             | 6            |
| 70             | 6               | 7            |
| 80             | 6.5             | 8            |
| 90             | 7               | 9            |
| 100            | 7.5             | 10           |
